source.election: UC Berkeley Statewide Database 2022 General (g22) SOV by SR precinct
source.score_formula: Illustrative focus (0–100) = 70% competitiveness from 2022 Assembly two-party margin + 30% turnout (TOTVOTE/TOTREG) in overlapping SR precincts, aggregated to place via SWDB SRPREC→city weights. Not a field targeting model.
